note: The hosted audio frame, stated once. The Client wire test (client/test/unit/dictation/hosted_dictation_wire_test.dart) and the Gateway's read-only mirror (backend/tests/unit/test_dictation_relay_wire_mirror.py) each assert this table against their own copy of this file, so the two sides of the relay cannot drift apart. Contract: docs/technical/dictation_transport_protocol.md section 6.2.

fields.name: dictation_id
fields.rule: The session identity, minted by the Client and immutable for the session.

fields.name: seq
fields.rule: Audio-frame index: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1 per admitted frame.

fields.name: data
fields.rule: Raw signed 16-bit little-endian samples as a socket.io binary attachment. Never base64, never a JSON string, never a JSON array of integers: an integer array is not raw bytes and the Gateway refuses it with invalid_request.
